label: CHECKPOINT_11A1_DEPENDENCY_SECURITY_AUDIT

npm_audit_omit_dev.conclusion: All production/runtime dependencies are free of HIGH/CRITICAL (and any severity) findings.

development_toolchain_findings.runtime_scope: dev-only, never shipped in the production build (`npm run build` output does not include vitest)
development_toolchain_findings.advisory_title: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary file can be read and executed
development_toolchain_findings.exploit_precondition_in_this_repo: The Vitest UI server (`vitest --ui`) is never started -- only `vitest run` (`npm test`) is used -- so this advisory's precondition does not apply to this project's actual test invocation.

development_toolchain_findings.direct_or_transitive: direct (devDependency, used only by the Vite dev/build tooling)
development_toolchain_findings.runtime_scope: dev-only build/dev-server tool, not bundled into `dist/`
development_toolchain_findings.dependency_path: frontend -> vite (direct devDependency); also frontend -> vitest -> vite-node -> vite (transitive)
development_toolchain_findings.advisory_title: vite: server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths
development_toolchain_findings.exploit_precondition_in_this_repo: Affects the Vite DEV server's static-file-serving path traversal guard on Windows; this project's dev server is only ever run locally against the developer's own machine (never exposed to untrusted network clients), and the vulnerability has no effect on `npm run build` output.

development_toolchain_findings.runtime_scope: dev-only, bundled only into the Vite dev-server toolchain
development_toolchain_findings.advisory_title: esbuild enables any website to send any requests to the development server and read the response
development_toolchain_findings.patched_version: 0.25.0+ (fixAvailable resolves via the same vite 8.2.2 major bump)

development_toolchain_findings.runtime_scope: dev-only, used only internally by vitest
development_toolchain_findings.advisory_title: Inherited from the vite advisory above (no independent CVE)

note: A non-breaking safe upgrade path was not available for any of these four findings -- the only fix npm reports for all of them is a semver-major jump (vite 5.x -> 8.x, vitest 1.x -> 4.x). Per Checkpoint 11A.1 instructions, no dependency version was changed merely to zero out this count; a proposed non-breaking-where-possible upgrade should be scoped and evaluated as its own separate change, not folded into this contract-hardening checkpoint.
